  obtain ⟨a, ⟨n, rfl⟩, hm⟩ := wellFounded_dvdNotUnit.has_min

  refine ⟨n, a, ?_, rfl⟩; rintro ⟨d, rfl⟩
  exact hm d ⟨n + 1, by rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc]⟩
